sqlite_primary_source.mechanism: jsonEachFilter resets parse state, converts full TEXT input to JSONB before path lookup, without jsonParseFuncArg cache; correlated full-report targets therefore reparses perpage.

assessment: Only four page SELECT sources and shared substitution change; existing WHERE parameters, ORDER BY, LIMIT and typed 21+5 column positions remain exact.
MATERIALIZED CTE retains key/value from the same metadata report row inside the unchanged caller transaction; target and renderer report-level parsing leave the per-page full-report target scan.
Immediate json_quote(json_extract(...)) is required: object/array subtype is retained before storage, whereas JSON-looking SQL text is quoted as a JSON string and cannot become a target container.

Missing operation targets become JSON null instead of an absent json_each path; the scalar subquery still yields SQL NULL in both forms. Scalar booleans become numeric 1/0 but still have no requested_url; string scalars retain the existing nested json_extract behavior.
Duplicate target order and first-match semantics are preserved because json_extract retains array/object serialization order and the subquery predicate/result are unchanged.

The four appended tests are actual SQLite projection controls authored only, not executed. The legacy oracle is frozen independently from accepted old source; unchanged row decoding cannot conceal a modified SQL projector.

All ten original test functions remain as an exact 28218-byte prefix. Retained source includes real selected-parent mixed-age, policy alias, malformed source/typed tail, readonly/reopen and full 405-page traversal regressions.
limitations: No formatter, compiler, SQLite connection, fixture, browser, native app, or install was executed by this review.
Materialization can allocate/copy the full report value once per statement. Neither latency nor RSS reduction is established by source inspection.

New source must pass fresh full 1203+4 function suite, formatter and Clippy, new optimized build and all unchanged native acceptance gates including physical CSV64MiB/AppJSON8MiB exact-plus-one cases.
Old physical run externally aborted after 524 seconds with 140 of 405 rows does not establish first-page hang, natural timeout, or a sole root cause.
Full vendor feature parity, platform parity, graceful HTTP in-flight drain and installation remain outside this review.
